thesis: Ben Horowitz argues that venture firms should evaluate general partners based on their performance at the point of investment rather than waiting for long-term portfolio outcomes. He explains that the firm's vertical structure allows small investing teams to scale while maintaining the intimacy of a five-person group, ensuring high concentration of talent and avoiding the pitfalls of large, bureaucratic teams.
